decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - : It is considered that this application for the demolition of the front extension of unit 6  and the creation of HGV parking and turning area would have no adverse impact on the trading estate, neighbouring properties, or to the character of the area.  The development is in accordance with the UDP policies ENV B.1.1 (New Development), E.2.3 (Improvement to employment sites) E.2.4	(Improvement to employment premises), E.3.1 (Disabled Access) T.1.4 ( Car and Cycle and servicing facilities for developments) within the Unitary Development Plan.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the frontage of the building hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 5 - The lorry parking  and turning spaces shown on drawing number 101 Rev B in front of Unit 6 shall be constructed and available for use before first occupation of any part of the development and such spaces shall not be used for any other purposes including the parking of private cars.

Condition : 6 - Before the development hereby permitted is commenced a scheme indicating the provision to be made for disabled people to gain access to Unit 6 in terms of access through doorways and level surfaces/ ramps shall have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The agreed scheme shall be implemented before the development hereby permitted is brought into use.
description: Demolition of the front extension, new front elevation and use of resulting concrete apron for parking of one HGV and general manoeuvring.
